functions.name: TIM_ARR
functions.exampleCode:
uint32_t v = TIM1->ARR;  /* 读回当前值 */
v &= ~TIM_ARR_ARR_Msk;  /* 先清掉 TIM_ARR_ARR：bits[31:0]（整个位域） */
v |= (1u << TIM_ARR_ARR_Pos) & TIM_ARR_ARR_Msk;  /* 置位，实际取值看参考手册 */
TIM1->ARR = v;  /* 写回 */
